gauge.remaining_reflections: Local rank/intervals do not exclude alternative reflected solutions
gauge.rule: Only declared fixed coordinates and selected height model are eliminated; remaining rigid freedoms remain in free coordinates and rank

numerical_contract.derivatives: Analytic physical metre geometry, range-loss transform and optional strict-interior LM chain rule
numerical_contract.range_residual: (predicted range - saved range)/saved sigma; actual and delivery times excluded
numerical_contract.survey_residual: Cholesky inverse times selected world beacon-minus-survey mean; independent blocks

diagnostics.selection_policy: Prefer converged finite attempts then minimum declared objective; hard-rejection masks can differ so objectives are not common-data quality scores

acquisition_metadata.delivery_latency_rule: delivery_time_s=actual_time_s+latency; never used in batch fitting
acquisition_metadata.grouping_rule: assume every ping in epoch occurs at estimator_input.times_s[epoch]
acquisition_metadata.range_noise_pairing: fixed Gaussian draw indexed by cycle and beacon, independent of missingness and timing

generation.dropout_definition: Independent Bernoulli selection after M5 acquisition selection; source pings and dropped records retained; missingness is not an estimator rejection.
generation.label_definition: nlos marks injected positive NLOS bias only; offsets, white/AR noise and quantization are separate factors
generation.nlos_prevalence_definition: Independent Bernoulli burst-onset probability per eligible beacon/cycle; forward union of duration-cycle windows. Realized contaminated fraction can exceed onset probability.
generation.noise_definition: AR(1) per beacon, stationary SD in metres, independent beacon streams; correlation is between adjacent cycle indices, not elapsed seconds. Base M5 white noise remains additive.
generation.order: M5 acquisition/white noise, beacon offset, stationary cycle-grid AR(1), positive NLOS, nearest-even quantization, independent dropout
generation.randomness: NumPy default_rng, SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3): onset, AR innovations, dropout
generation.uncertainty_definition: sigma_m is the original assumed M5 range SD; not silently inflated for contamination or quantization

acquisition_metadata.delivery_latency_rule: delivery_time_s=actual_time_s+latency; never used in batch fitting
acquisition_metadata.grouping_rule: assume every ping in epoch occurs at estimator_input.times_s[epoch]
acquisition_metadata.range_noise_pairing: fixed Gaussian draw indexed by cycle and beacon, independent of missingness and timing

source_experiment.coordinate_convention: World Cartesian metres for synthetic truth/surveyed maps; estimator joint gauge is separately disclosed in run diagnostics

motion.endpoint_rule: Position holds at path endpoints and outside [0,duration]; speed is zero while held
motion.height_parameterization: tilted: z=offset+tan(tilt)*(x-5m); excursion: offset+A*sin(2pi*t/T); spatial adds .45A*sin(6pi*t/T+.2); endpoint times hold
motion.path_parameterization: reference path arclength; narrow coverage uses dense polyline
motion.profile_node_units: fraction of duration, signed relative speed; variable profile normalized by peak forward excursion

coverage.definition: Retained means positive final influence weight; missing/dropout observations are outside estimator counts

alignment.description: Declared partial-survey world frame retained; no fitted translation, rotation, scale or reflection
Declared partial-survey world frame retained; no fitted translation, rotation, scale or reflection

rejection_evaluation.definition: Injected positive NLOS labels evaluated only after independent fitting. Gaussian/continuous-loss decisions use weight < weight_decision_threshold; hard rejection decisions use frozen zero weight. Dropped pings excluded; undefined denominator=null. Other contamination factors are not NLOS labels.

uncertainty.fixed_coordinates_are: Exact declared constraints eliminated from the free vector, not extra noisy rows
uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional local linear Gaussian approximation with known sigma, no residual variance rescaling. With priors this is a local Gaussian posterior approximation, not unconditional frequentist coverage.
uncertainty.interval_definition: Two-sided marginal 95% normal approximation; fixed geometry components have conditional zero variance by declaration
uncertainty.jacobian_definition: d[(predicted range - saved range)/saved sigma]/d[physical metre coordinates]; survey whitened by Cholesky inverse
limitations: Full local rank is not global uniqueness; undiscovered or reflected geometries are excluded.
No coverage calibration is claimed; known-sigma Gaussian assumptions can be misspecified.
Correlation, quantization, contamination, timing/height mismatch and fixed survey bias can invalidate intervals.
Weighted information and positive robust curvature are conditioning diagnostics, not calibrated covariance.
uncertainty.prior_model: Independent Gaussian quadratic motion/height assumptions, independent of ranges and survey
uncertainty.survey_model: Independent Gaussian blocks across rows; covariance couples selected axes within a row
